links.note: The closing क्रिया -- बैठ घड़ी भर, गाना, उड़ जाना -- is the framing image of the पीपल की डाली, 30267. 30284 covers the नभीय विचरण theme, not this return to the opening scene.
Suggestions to stop the fall in पक्षियों की संख्या -- the करुणा and मिलजुलकर-सुंदर-संसार disposition of 30270. 30269 covers the कवि's own preoccupation with प्रकृति, not the reader's duty of care.
मानवता से द्रोह-भावना explained -- man's शत्रुता, the opposite of the प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति of 30272. 30274 covers the सीखो-तुम-हमसे address in the same stanza.
What the प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति line inspires -- प्रेम and आपसी सौहार्द, 30272. 30268 covers the बोली carrying a संदेश, not its content.
सीमा-हीन गगन में उड़ते, निर्भय विचरण teaches breaking needless बंधन -- 30284. 30276 covers freedom from लोभ, not from boundaries.
The नैतिक शिक्षाएँ given to मनुष्य through the चिड़िया -- 30274's सीखो तुम हमसे जीना जग में. 30271 lists the कविता's मूल भाव; here it is what मानव is to learn.
The प्रकृति-and-पक्षी bond as the कविता draws it -- असीम आकाश as घर and स्वतंत्र विचरण, 30284. 30269 covers the कवि's reputation for writing प्रकृति, not this relationship inside the poem.
मुक्ति-मंत्र for the बंदी मानव, with the बंधन named -- 30284's बंधन-versus-स्वच्छंद-विचरण. 30275 covers which जीवन to choose rather than the mantra of release.
What she urges मनुष्य to learn in the कविता's last part -- 30274's केंद्रीय संबोधन. 30284 covers the सोने की कड़ियाँ themselves, which the answer reaches only through that appeal.
The कविता का मूल भाव, asked by name -- 30271. 30269 covers आरसी प्रसाद सिंह as a कवि; the item asks for the poem's core भाव.
मनुष्य की सीमाएँ against the पक्षियों की स्वतंत्रता, and which way the कवि leans -- 30284's comparison. 30275 covers the जीवन recommended, not the contrast itself.
मनुष्य complicating his जीवन by leaving प्राकृतिक जीवन -- the सरल/स्वच्छंद life against संचय that 30275 asks students to settle. 30284 covers the गगन image, not the simple-life recommendation.
The birds' सामूहिक जीवन without भेदभाव against man's walls -- the समानता और एकता of 30273. 30284 covers the boundless आसमान; this item's point is their undivided living.
Who वे are in वे कहते हैं, मानव! सीखो -- the पक्षी who address मानव, 30274. 30267 covers the single चिड़िया of the पीपल की डाली.
Who are स्वच्छंद -- the पक्षी; स्वच्छंदता is 30284's नभीय विचरण. 30274 covers their address to मानव, not the freedom attributed to them.
Who sits घड़ी भर on the पीपल and sings -- the चिड़िया of 30267's scene. 30274 covers the birds' speech to मानव.
What the पक्षी teach मनुष्य -- to live मिलजुलकर and स्वतंत्रतापूर्वक, 30274's address. 30273 covers their own mutual living, not the teaching directed at मानव.
हम स्वच्छंद और क्यों तुमने डाली है बेड़ी पग में explained -- स्वच्छंदता against मनुष्य की बेड़ी, 30284. 30274 covers the appeal to learn.
Whose मन holds no लोभ -- the पक्षियों का; 30276. 30273 covers their living together, not their greedlessness.
What their own श्रम brings them -- संतोष; 30276's take-only-what-you-earn. 30270 covers what they leave औरों के हित.
Where they fly -- असीम गगन में, 30284's सीमा-हीन sky. 30273 covers the shared वन.
लोभ नहीं, पाप नहीं, परवाह नहीं explained -- no लालच, no बुराई, no चिंता: 30276. 30272 covers the प्रेम-प्रीति teaching.
जग का सारा माल हड़पकर explained -- no wish to own the world's संपत्ति, 30276. 30270 covers the surplus left for others.
Where all the पक्षी live हिलमिल -- वन में; 30273's own line. 30284 covers the आसमान as their घर, which is the next line.
The पक्षियों का घर is the आसमान -- 30284. 30273 covers the वन where they mingle, not the sky as home.
Where they sleep at night -- पेड़ों पर, the closing half of the दिन-भर-काम line that 30276 holds as their unaccumulating routine. 30284 covers the आसमान as घर rather than the night roost.
Which पक्षी live in the वन -- the roster of 30273's हिलमिल line. 30284 covers the गगन they fly in.
How all the पक्षी live -- मिल-जुलकर, 30273's समानता और एकता. 30276 covers their श्रम and संतोष.
Through whom the कवि sends his संदेश -- the चिड़िया's बोली, 30268. 30267 covers the scene she sings from.
Where she is sitting -- the पीपल की ऊँची शाखा, 30267. 30268 covers the संदेश she carries.
What she conveys in her बोली -- कोई संदेश; 30268 verbatim. 30272 covers that the संदेश's content is प्रेम-प्रीति.
Naming the पाठ and its कवि, आरसी प्रसाद सिंह -- 30269 is the कवि concept. 30271 covers the कविता's मूल भाव, not its authorship.
The प्रश्न the कवि puts to us -- do you know what her बोली says: 30268's own क्या तुम उसे समझते हो. 30267 covers the perch and the singing.
Where the चिड़िया sits in the काव्यांश -- पीपल की ऊँची डाली पर, 30267. 30268 covers her संदेश.

What the संदेश in her बोली could mean -- an उपदेश of प्रेम and सद्भाव; the item reads the संदेश that 30268 names. 30272 covers the प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति as a teaching, but here the word संदेश is what is being interpreted.

Who inspires मानव to become स्वतंत्र and निःस्वार्थ -- the चिड़िया, whose address is 30274's सीखो तुम हमसे जीना. 30272 covers the प्रेम-प्रीति teaching; freedom and selflessness are what this item keys.
Where and in what वातावरण her गाना is heard -- the पीपल की ऊँची डाली and its calm; 30267's scene. 30268 covers the संदेश rather than the setting.
What the कवि expects of मनुष्य in तुम्हें ज्ञात क्या -- that he try to read her संदेश; 30268's own question. 30274 covers the birds' address, not the कवि's expectation of attention.
Which पक्षी the काव्यांश names -- काक, हंस, शुक from 30273's हिलमिल roster. 30284 covers the आसमान as their घर.

The options make students pick what हिलमिल रहना points to, against दुश्मनी, अलगाव and डर -- exactly the choose-the-भाव drill 30281 names for this line. 30273 states the line's meaning outright, which is a separate item in this chapter's first file.
जहाँ चाहते, जाते हैं shows स्वच्छंदता -- 30284's free wandering. 30273 covers their togetherness, not their freedom of movement.
How the different पक्षी behave with one another -- हिलमिलकर, eating together, एकता: 30273. 30276 covers their श्रम and संतोष.
आसमान ही उनका घर and how it shapes their जीवन -- boundless स्वतंत्रता, 30284. 30273 covers the वन where they mingle.
Which भावना मानव is urged to abandon -- शत्रुता और विद्वेष, i.e. द्रोह-भावना, the opposite of the प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति of 30272. 30274 covers the सीखो address of the same stanza.
What she comes to the पीपल की डाली to convey -- the संदेश of प्रेम and मानवता; 30268's यही सुनाने आती है. 30267 covers the perch and the brief stay.
बैठ घड़ी भर, गा कर फिर उड़ जाती है as her fleeting presence -- the framing image of 30267. 30284 covers the नभीय विचरण theme, not this closing picture.
मानवता से द्रोह-भावना explained and why it must go -- the शत्रुता set against the प्रेम-प्रीति की रीति of 30272. 30270 covers the कवि's करुणा generally, not this line's demand.
The purpose of her coming and singing -- to convey the संदेश, 30268. 30267 covers the पीपल की डाली scene itself.
Whose मन holds no लोभ, पाप or परवाह -- the पक्षियों का; 30276. 30273 covers their shared living.
माल हड़पकर as a संतोषी, निःस्वार्थ प्रवृत्ति -- 30276's no-संचय. 30270 covers the surplus left औरों के हित.
How they feed themselves -- अपने परिश्रम से; 30276's take-what-you-earn. 30273 covers मिल-जुलकर खाना.
The negative भावनाएँ they are free of and what मनुष्य learns -- लोभ and its kin, 30276. 30274 covers the address to मानव; this item keys the freedom from लोभ.
माल हड़पकर as a जीवन दर्शन of no जमाखोरी -- 30276 exactly. 30275 frames the स्वच्छंद-or-संचय choice as a decision for students; here the birds' own philosophy is asked.
